verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing docs describe setting rules for spend, documentation, and approvers that are applied to every transaction (brex-docs-8), category-style limits for stipends, travel, and procurement with auto-enforcement and automatic blocking of out-of-policy purchases (brex-docs-9, brex-docs-36), and a review agent that auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions to humans (brex-docs-16, brex-docs-41). Role-based routing is shown only for bill-pay approvals (brex-docs-11). missing for 10: explicit evidence of role- and context-specific expense limits, in-depth configuration docs for policy rules beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-approval behavior.
